RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenDefeat.fr: Je me rends !\nTu es meilleur technicien !

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenIntro.en: My POKéMON techniques will leave\nyou crying!

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenPostBattle.en: In mountains, you'll often find\nROCK-type POKéMON.
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenPostBattle.fr: En montagne, on trouve souvent des\nPOKéMON de type ROCHE.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperIntro.en: You have a POKéDEX?\nI want one, too.
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperIntro.fr: Tu as un POKéDEX ?\nJ'en veux un aussi.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperPostBattle.en: When you finish your POKéDEX,\ncan I have it?
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperPostBattle.fr: Quand tu auras fini ton POKéDEX,\nje peux l'avoir ?

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyPostBattle.en: I go for power because I hate\nthinking.
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyPostBattle.fr: Je joue la puissance parce que je\ndéteste réfléchir.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricIntro.en: Hit me with your best shot!

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricPostBattle.en: I'll raise my POKéMON to beat\nyours, kid.
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricPostBattle.fr: J'élèverai mes POKéMON pour battre\nles tiens.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaIntro.en: I don't often come here, but I will\nbattle you.
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaIntro.fr: Je viens rarement ici, mais je te\ncombattrai.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaPostBattle.en: I like tiny POKéMON.\nBig ones are too scary!
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaPostBattle.fr: J'aime les petits POKéMON.\nLes gros font trop peur !

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MonSlowpoke.en: SLOWPOKE: ...Yawn.\nIt dozes in the cool air.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaIntro.en: Do you know how you can avoid\ngetting lost in the mountains?\pYou can bend twigs as trail\nmarkers.
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaIntro.fr: Sais-tu comment éviter de te perdre\nen montagne ?\pTu peux plier des brindilles comme\nrepères de sentier.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaPostBattle.fr: Je veux rentrer à la maison !

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SteveIntro.en: Um… Do you know about POKéMON\ncosplay?

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_StevePostBattle.en: POKéMON cosplay is dressing up as\nPOKéMON for fun.\pCLEFAIRY is a favorite.
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_StevePostBattle.fr: Le cosplay POKéMON, c'est se\ndéguiser en POKéMON pour s'amuser.\pMÉLOFÉE est un favori.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonIntro.en: I draw illustrations of POKéMON\nwhen I'm home.
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonIntro.fr: Je dessine des illustrations de\nPOKéMON quand je suis chez moi.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonPostBattle.en: I'm an artist, not a fighter.\nI'll go home to draw.
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonPostBattle.fr: Je suis un artiste, pas un\ncombattant. Je rentre dessiner.
